purpose: Evaluate alternative trainer, normal-vendor or world-schematic crafts before spending Merchant Favor, without Favor-to-Favor comparisons.
rules: Alternatives must be crafted from a recipe not sold for Merchant Favor.
Compare function or ability with stated practical differences, not merely equipment slot or similar names.
Reusable thrown satchels are not treated as equivalent to consumed bombs.
Comparisons with a large level difference are allowed only for strongly overlapping gadget functionality and explicitly state the mismatch.
Report an unavailable alternative honestly rather than inventing one.
Crafted output IDs are separate from schematic IDs.

alternatives.name: Gnomish Cloaking Device
alternatives.similarity: Both grant concealment through crafted Engineering gadgets.
alternatives.differences: Stealthman 52 (item level 60, required level 55) lasts up to 1 min while stationary, 6 sec after moving, cannot activate during combat, and has 5-min cooldown.
